Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect already returned the Digimon to their hand. The effect doesn't activate again, and the Digimon you chose remains in your opponent's hand.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 7 cards in hand. I use this card to return their Digimon to their hand, resulting in them having 8 cards in hand. Does my opponent place that Digimon at the bottom of their deck?

Effect: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand, instead return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.
